note.fr: Avoir au moins 18 ans au début des études (fin septembre 2026) et un bon niveau d'anglais ; vérifier les critères d'admission exacts sur la page « Application Criteria and Deadlines ».
note.en: Be at least 18 years old by the start of studies (end of September 2026) and have a good command of English; check the exact admission criteria on the 'Application Criteria and Deadlines' page.

evidence.quote: Applicants must be at least 18 years old by the start of the study period in the Fall semester of Year 1 at the University, i.e., by the end of September 2026.
Obuda University seeks students who possess a strong background and interest in STEM fields, a good command of English, and a strong motivation to study at Obuda University.
